archetype: Pastel & Soft with Neo-Brutalist Pop (Fun, energetic, approachable, high-trust peer-to-peer swapping)

entry_surfaces./: editorial split hero — bold tag + value proposition + interactive credit calculator left, visual seeded item swap duel right
entry_surfaces./browse: dense marketplace bento — search bar + category pill filters top, sticky credit estimator sidebar, item card grid
entry_surfaces./items/:id: product immersion split — high-res gallery + swapper badge left, credit formula breakdown + 'Propose Swap' selector drawer right
entry_surfaces./create-listing: focused wizard panel — 2-column live value-to-credit estimator with visual tier badge and shipping disclaimer
entry_surfaces./dashboard: compact command center — credit wallet status banner + pending proposals tabbed matrix + my active swap garage
entry_surfaces./credits: playful 4-tier pricing grid with highlighted 'Popular 50 Credits' card, Stripe checkout trigger, and refund policy badge
entry_surfaces./payment-success: celebration card modal with animated credit counter and quick CTA to browse items

credit_calculation_formula.rule_description: Each party pays the item's credit cost upon swap acceptance. Both swappers pay their own packaging and postage.

business_logic_rules.shipping_rule: The sender arranges postage and packaging at their own expense.

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite/React frontend with Tailwind v4).
Implement the live interactive Swap Credit Calculator directly on the landing page hero and create listing pages.
Implement the 4 Credit Packs (€1.99, €3.99, €6.99, €9.99) with Stripe checkout flow and simulated instant checkout for seamless testing.
Implement realistic seeded listings (vintage cameras, audio gear, retro games, designer apparel, instruments) with genuine images from the provided image URLs.
Ensure every interactive element has kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='buy-credits-pack-20', data-testid='propose-swap-button').
Include mock Google OAuth sign in and a 'Facebook sign-in (coming soon)' button.
Highlight clearly: 'Postage & Packaging is paid by each sender directly when swapping'.
